liveTargets.text: 回答後至少補一句具體細節（原因、感受、例子），再交回話題
同上 — 仍未穩定做到，繼續
先完整回答 → 一個具體細節 → 再交回話題（不要話沒說完就丟回去）
挑戰：60–90 秒講完 Stranger Things 故事，短句、不重啟（尚未驗收）
每個回答結尾完成一個簡短的交回問題 — 預設就用 What about you?
把完整想法說完，再切換成問單字／文法（學習模式排在對話之後）
補一個具體細節後就交回話題 — 給第二段解釋之前，先把發言權還給對方
一句話一個完整想法 — 說完一句再加下一個細節或問題，不要邊講邊改

patterns.name: 回答太短就結束
patterns.zh: 只給一個事實就停，對方沒東西可接

patterns.name: 誤解不修復
patterns.zh: 對方明顯會錯意時沒有立刻澄清

patterns.name: 沒先回答就交回／交回沒說完
patterns.zh: 回答完沒交回話題，或問題/句子說一半放棄（Yeah, what about... / Have you ever...）

patterns.name: 句子重啟
patterns.zh: 邊講邊修、重複開頭或把問題重組好幾次，不整句重來（已成為目前最大痛點）

patterns.name: 轉場突兀
patterns.zh: 換話題沒有承接上一句（少一個 Thanks.）

patterns.name: 中途切換問英文
patterns.zh: 話題講到一半停下來問單字用法，打斷對話流（真實面試會很突兀）

patterns.name: 解釋太長沒交回
patterns.zh: 一個話題連講多層解釋，變成小型簡報，對方插不上話（義法料理比較）

patterns.name: 敏感話題框架
patterns.zh: 把族群和犯罪率連在一起問安全 — 職場紅線；要改問地區、時段、交通方式

priorities.t: 一句一個想法，說完再繼續
priorities.why: 兩場 08/06 都因邊講邊修而大量重啟（句子重啟已 5 場出現）；長解釋用三句法：主張→例子→交回
問治安時問地區／時段／交通（rideshare），絕不把族群和犯罪連在一起 — 職場紅線，一次就會傷信任

priorities.t: 複數與動詞一致（各已 3 次）
priorities.why: 80 degrees、those videos；wins／snows 加 s；did＋原形、has＋過去分詞

errors.right: Sorry, I didn't catch that. / Could you say that again?
errors.rule: repeat 已含「再一次」，加 again 是贅字

errors.right: How was your weekend?
errors.rule: 問已經結束的週末要用過去式

errors.right: The sound and lighting effects were amazing.
errors.rule: 描述過去的體驗用 were，不用 is/are

errors.right: I really admire you.
errors.rule: admire 是動詞，前面不能加 am/is/are

errors.right: I already had lunch.
errors.rule: 「吃過午餐了」的固定說法，不加 for my

errors.right: two slices of bread
errors.rule: bread 不可數：slices 加 s、bread 不加

errors.right: order a double espresso
errors.rule: 可數的飲料單點要加 a

errors.wrong: put into a fridge / put it into air fryer
errors.right: put it in the fridge / in the air fryer
errors.rule: put 要接受詞 it；家電用 the

errors.right: work out / I usually exercise after dinner.
errors.rule: 美式口語用 work out，或把 exercise 直接當動詞

errors.right: I usually grab coffee...
errors.rule: normally 和 usually 同義，擇一即可

errors.right: mix it with whole milk
errors.rule: mix 要接受詞 it（指 espresso）

errors.wrong: I went to watch her movie. → "Odyssey."
errors.right: I went to see a movie called Odyssey. It was pretty interesting.
errors.rule: go see a movie 是固定說法；片名和活動放同一句，避免對方猜

errors.wrong: I think I will be good. / I think now I'm good.
errors.right: I think I'll be okay. / I think I'm ready now.
errors.rule: 預期面試表現用 be okay / ready / feel prepared，good 太模糊

errors.wrong: I'm gonna interview for a junior associate.
errors.right: I'm interviewing for a junior associate position.
errors.rule: interview for + 職位要加 position/role

errors.right: The drive was pretty smooth.
errors.rule: 描述通勤講 the drive / traffic，且用過去式

errors.wrong: What show do you watch lately?
errors.right: What shows have you been watching lately?
errors.rule: 「最近」的持續行為用現在完成進行式

errors.right: instant noodles
errors.rule: 泛指泡麵這種食物用複數

errors.right: drugs on campus
errors.rule: 校園裡固定用 on campus

errors.right: They're going to protect...
errors.rule: gonna 前面仍要有 be 動詞

errors.wrong: How do this agent... / It fall off... / Berry cornbread win...
errors.right: How do these agents... / It falls off the bone. / Berry cornbread wins for me.
errors.rule: 主詞單複數要和動詞一致（第三人稱單數動詞加 s）

errors.right: The story is about... / The show deals with...
errors.rule: 介紹劇情用 is about / follows / deals with

errors.right: this March / in March
errors.rule: this + 月份前不加 in

errors.right: The burrito has ground beef.
errors.rule: 講食物內容 has 比 contains 口語自然

errors.right: Mexican-blend cheese
errors.rule: 起司名稱固定講法

errors.right: this weekend
errors.rule: 指最近這個週末用 this weekend；複數指未來多個週末

errors.right: my building's lobby
errors.rule: 公寓大廳講 building's lobby / apartment lobby

errors.right: But ...
errors.rule: 閒聊中 but 比 However 自然，However 太書面

errors.right: And done! / Five minutes later, it's ready.
errors.rule: 「完成！」是 done 不是 down

errors.right: heat it for five minutes
errors.rule: heat 要接受詞 it

errors.right: I'm more of a coffee person.
errors.rule: coffee or tea 這類二選一問題：I'm more of a ___ person

errors.right: grab a coffee / grab a cup
errors.rule: 職場快速拿杯咖啡用 grab 更自然

errors.wrong: The reason why I go to there is because of the Universal Studio.
errors.right: I went there mainly for Universal Studios.
errors.rule: 過去的旅行用過去式；there 前不加 to；片名是 Universal Studios（有 s）

errors.wrong: This is the day that my girlfriend will receive her salary.
errors.right: My girlfriend gets paid this Friday.
errors.rule: 發薪的固定說法是 get paid

errors.wrong: Same as me. / The same is yours.
errors.right: Same here. / Mine was about the same.
errors.rule: 「我也一樣」就說 Same here

errors.right: It's been a busy Monday.
errors.rule: 描述今天過得如何用 It's been a ___

errors.right: I've seen that in Houston.
errors.rule: 現在完成式要有 have：I've seen；並補受詞 that

errors.right: a hint of smokiness / a smoky, savory flavor
errors.rule: a hint of + 名詞；形容詞要修飾 flavor 不能單獨掛著

errors.right: No problem. I'm happy to wait.
errors.rule: 餐廳等位用 I'm happy to wait 比 I will wait 自然

errors.wrong: a Mexican restaurant, who is operated by...
errors.right: a Mexican restaurant that is run by a well-known Mexican chef
errors.rule: 餐廳是物，關係代名詞用 that/which（who 只用於人）；口語用 run by 不用 operated by

errors.wrong: you can easily access to seafood
errors.right: you can easily access seafood / you have easy access to seafood
errors.rule: access 當動詞直接接受詞；名詞用法才是 have access to

errors.wrong: those type of dish / 80 degree / those long video
errors.right: those types of dishes / 80 degrees / those long videos
errors.rule: 數字大於 1、those、any（泛問）後面都要複數

errors.right: Traffic was a little backed up. / I got stuck in traffic.
errors.rule: 塞車是 traffic backed up；stuck 描述人或車（I was stuck in traffic）

errors.right: around 300 restaurants are participating in Restaurant Week
errors.rule: 參加活動的標準說法是 participate in / take part

errors.wrong: enjoy this restaurant with a good price
errors.right: try the restaurant at a good price
errors.rule: 價格用 at a good price，不用 with

errors.right: in France / when it comes to French cuisine
errors.rule: France 是國家、French 是形容詞（法國菜可說 French cuisine）

errors.wrong: I don't know when, when is the specific time, but I know it's gonna open.
errors.right: I'm not sure exactly when it's opening, but I heard it's coming soon.
errors.rule: 用 coming soon，避免重複的間接問句結構

errors.wrong: In St. Louis is snows every winter.
errors.right: In St. Louis, it snows every winter.
errors.rule: 天氣句需要虛主詞 it

errors.right: I've been there once.
errors.rule: there 是副詞，前面不加 to

errors.right: any plans for the upcoming holidays
errors.rule: 泛問計畫用複數 plans

errors.right: a three-day weekend / three days off
errors.rule: 連假是 long weekend；vacation 指較長的休假

errors.wrong: Is there any words to try?
errors.right: Are there any other foods I should try?
errors.rule: 類別是食物（foods/dishes）不是 words；複數配 Are

errors.right: Did anything fun happen?
errors.rule: did 之後動詞用原形

errors.wrong: My girlfriend has already get off work.
errors.right: My girlfriend just got off work.
errors.rule: has/have 之後用過去分詞；這裡用 just got 更自然

errors.wrong: People are hard to focus on the long video.
errors.right: It's hard for people to focus on long videos.
errors.rule: 表達困難用 It is hard for + 人 + to V

errors.wrong: I will watch a TV show or scrolling my phone.
errors.right: I watch a show or scroll on my phone.
errors.rule: or 連接的動詞形式要平行

errors.wrong: How was your plan for dinner?
errors.right: What's your plan for dinner? / What are you doing for dinner?
errors.rule: 問計畫用 what，不用 how

errors.wrong: heat the pot to the median heat
errors.right: heat the pot over medium heat
errors.rule: 火候是 medium（median 是統計中位數）；介系詞用 over

errors.right: once it comes to a boil
errors.rule: 固定用語 come to a boil，a 不能省

errors.wrong: Pick it up from my left off.
errors.right: I picked up where I left off.
errors.rule: 固定用語 pick up where you left off＝從上次停的地方繼續

phrases.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that.
phrases.zh: 最常用的「沒聽清楚」— 取代 repeat again

phrases.en: Could you say that again?
phrases.zh: 請對方再說一次

phrases.en: Sorry, could you repeat the last part?
phrases.zh: 指明是「最後一段」沒聽到

phrases.en: Sorry, what do you mean by 'go-to'?
phrases.zh: 針對特定字詞問意思

phrases.en: The drive was pretty smooth.
phrases.zh: 通勤順利的標準回答

phrases.en: I left a little early just in case.
phrases.zh: 補一句細節：提早出門以防萬一

phrases.en: Traffic wasn't too bad this morning.
phrases.zh: 今早車流還好

phrases.en: Is traffic usually this light around here?
phrases.zh: 交回話題的好問題

phrases.en: I'm a little nervous, but I feel prepared.
phrases.zh: 緊張但準備好了

phrases.en: It's a big step, but I'm excited to get started.
phrases.zh: 回應「這是一大步」時，加入情緒往前推

phrases.en: Is it usually pretty busy here in the mornings?
phrases.zh: 把話題交回去的問題

phrases.en: Got anything fun planned this weekend?
phrases.zh: 最自然的週末開場問句

phrases.en: What are you up to this weekend?
phrases.zh: 同上的變化型

phrases.en: I'll probably just catch up on rest. Nothing too wild.
phrases.zh: catch up on rest＝補眠；nothing too wild＝沒特別安排

phrases.en: Are you just going to take it easy?
phrases.zh: take it easy＝放鬆不排行程

phrases.en: Thanks. How was your weekend?
phrases.zh: 先承接上一句（Thanks）再換話題 — 轉場關鍵字

phrases.en: I already had lunch. I had ___ with ___.
phrases.zh: 吃過了＋內容的句型

phrases.en: That sounds cozy. Do you usually eat a light lunch?
phrases.zh: 回應對方的簡單午餐

phrases.en: What's your go-to lunch?
phrases.zh: go-to＝最常選的、口袋名單

phrases.en: What do you usually put in it?
phrases.zh: 問食物內容

phrases.en: That's a solid combo.
phrases.zh: 稱讚食材搭配

phrases.en: Can't forget the cheese. That ties it all together.
phrases.zh: tie it all together＝讓整體更完整

phrases.en: Have you watched anything good lately?
phrases.zh: 問影集的萬用開場

phrases.en: That sounds interesting. What's it about?
phrases.zh: 接對方提到的影集

phrases.en: It's about... / It follows... / The show deals with...
phrases.zh: 介紹劇情的三個句型

phrases.en: Did it feel more like a drama or an action show?
phrases.zh: 不能只答 yes/no 的好問題

phrases.en: Would you recommend it?
phrases.zh: 收尾追問

phrases.en: I went to see a movie called ___. It was pretty interesting.
phrases.zh: 活動＋片名＋反應，一句講完

phrases.en: I can see why it pulled you in.
phrases.zh: pull you in＝讓人入坑

phrases.en: This Houston heat is brutal.
phrases.zh: 抱怨熱的自然說法

phrases.en: The humidity is the real kicker, right?
phrases.zh: the real kicker＝最要命的部分

phrases.en: A movie might be the perfect choice in this weather.
phrases.zh: 天氣→電影的轉場

phrases.en: Maybe you could go for a walk after it cools down.
phrases.zh: after it cools down＝等涼一點

phrases.en: I usually work out after dinner. What about you?
phrases.zh: 先回答＋再交回的標準示範

phrases.en: Do you usually go in the morning, or do you squeeze it in after work?
phrases.zh: squeeze it in＝忙碌中擠出時間

phrases.en: That's impressive. I could never work out before work.
phrases.zh: 完整版稱讚：評價＋個人反應

phrases.en: Speaking of ...
phrases.zh: 從對方話題接到自己經驗 — S3 用得很好

phrases.en: That reminds me...
phrases.zh: 想到相關的事

phrases.en: By the way...
phrases.zh: 順帶一提

phrases.en: Since we're talking about shows...
phrases.zh: 順著目前主題延伸

phrases.en: That must have been incredible. What was the best part?
phrases.zh: 回應別人的精彩經驗＋追問

phrases.en: That sounds intense.
phrases.zh: 聽起來很刺激／很硬

phrases.en: It must have felt really immersive.
phrases.zh: immersive＝身歷其境

phrases.en: It was really nice talking to you.
phrases.zh: 比 nice to talk to you 更自然

phrases.en: Have a good one.
phrases.zh: 輕鬆道別

phrases.en: Good luck in there.
phrases.zh: 對要進面試／會議的人說

phrases.en: Thanks—I appreciate it.
phrases.zh: 回應對方的鼓勵

phrases.en: What about you?
phrases.zh: 最短、永遠可用的交回問題 — 要說完整，不要 Yeah, what about... 就斷掉

phrases.en: Do you work out too?
phrases.zh: 具體版交回問題（運動話題）

phrases.en: Are you a coffee person?
phrases.zh: 具體版交回問題（咖啡話題）

phrases.en: Hang on, let me finish my thought.
phrases.zh: 被打斷時禮貌保住發言權

phrases.en: I'm definitely more of a coffee person.
phrases.zh: 回答 coffee or tea 的直接開場

phrases.en: There's free coffee in the lobby, so I usually grab a cup after my workout.
phrases.zh: 細節句：免費咖啡＋運動後喝

phrases.en: What do you usually get?
phrases.zh: 問對方常點什麼

phrases.en: It helps me unwind after the day.
phrases.zh: unwind＝放鬆 — 晚上運動的好理由

phrases.en: What are you looking forward to this weekend?
phrases.zh: 比 any plans 更有溫度的週末問句

phrases.en: I caught up on some errands and relaxed.
phrases.zh: errands＝雜事；週末沒特別安排時的萬用回答

phrases.en: What's one place you'd love to visit again?
phrases.zh: 旅遊話題開場

phrases.en: What's your favorite city you've been to?
phrases.zh: 問最喜歡的城市

phrases.en: What stood out to you the most?
phrases.zh: stood out＝印象最深 — 旅遊/經驗的萬用追問

phrases.en: What kind of music do you usually listen to?
phrases.zh: 音樂話題開場

phrases.en: Have you been to any concerts recently?
phrases.zh: 延伸問句

phrases.en: It's been a busy Monday.
phrases.zh: 描述今天過得如何的標準句

phrases.en: Same here.
phrases.zh: 「我也一樣」— 取代 same as me

phrases.en: What time do you get off work?
phrases.zh: get off work＝下班

phrases.en: Are you heading home after this?
phrases.zh: 下班話題的自然延伸

phrases.en: Do you have a table for two?
phrases.zh: 進門第一句

phrases.en: Can you put us on the waitlist?
phrases.zh: 排隊候位

phrases.en: How long is the wait?
phrases.zh: 問要等多久

phrases.en: How many parties are ahead of us?
phrases.zh: parties＝組客人，問前面還有幾組

phrases.en: No problem. I'm happy to wait.
phrases.zh: 比 I will wait 自然的等位回應

phrases.en: The brisket is incredibly tender, with a rich smoky flavor and just a hint of spice.
phrases.zh: 口感＋風味＋一點辣 — BBQ 描述模板

phrases.en: melt-in-your-mouth / fall-off-the-bone
phrases.zh: 入口即化／骨肉分離 — 口感詞

phrases.en: I'm starving. I think I need to grab a burger.
phrases.zh: 比 I'm so hungry 生動，還順便開話題

phrases.en: Thanks so much for your help. I really appreciate it.
phrases.zh: 對服務人員/維修人員道謝

phrases.en: Traffic was a little backed up, but not terrible.
phrases.zh: backed up＝塞車的標準說法

phrases.en: It added about fifteen minutes to my commute.
phrases.zh: 補細節：多花了 15 分鐘

phrases.en: Houston Restaurant Week is going on right now—around 300 restaurants are participating.
phrases.zh: 兩句講完餐廳週，記得用 participating

phrases.en: Have you looked at any of the menus?
phrases.zh: 介紹完活動的收尾問句

phrases.en: Any spot on your list you are thinking of checking out?
phrases.zh: 問對方口袋名單

phrases.en: I'm eyeing this little Italian place I've heard about.
phrases.zh: eyeing＝考慮中還沒決定

phrases.en: I'm curious to see whether it lives up to the hype.
phrases.zh: live up to the hype＝名不虛傳

phrases.en: To me, Italian food is more ingredient-driven, while French food is more technique-driven. Which one do you prefer?
phrases.zh: 比較公式：一個對比→一個偏好→交回問句

phrases.en: That's just my impression, though. / Either way, I'd happily eat both.
phrases.zh: 話題變太學術時的收尾句

phrases.en: I'm still getting used to the Houston heat.
phrases.zh: 新來的人聊天氣萬用開場

phrases.en: When does the weather normally start cooling down?
phrases.zh: 交回問題：什麼時候開始轉涼

phrases.en: My girlfriend and I are planning to drive to New Orleans over Labor Day weekend.
phrases.zh: 連假旅行計畫的完整說法

phrases.en: I've been once for a conference, but I didn't really get to explore.
phrases.zh: 去過但沒玩到 — 一句講完不重啟

phrases.en: What would you recommend for a first real visit?
phrases.zh: 請對方推薦

phrases.en: I've heard safety varies a lot by neighborhood. Are there any areas tourists should avoid at night?
phrases.zh: 中性安全問法：問地區與時段，絕不連結族群

phrases.en: Is it better to use rideshare after dark?
phrases.zh: 問交通方式

phrases.en: It really depends on where you are and when.
phrases.zh: 對方常用的回答，也可以自己用

phrases.en: I've heard of gumbo, but I'm not exactly sure what it is. Is it more like a stew, or more like a rice dish?
phrases.zh: 問陌生食物：提出具體假設讓對方糾正

phrases.en: Besides beignets, what other dishes should I try?
phrases.zh: 請對方推薦其他菜（dishes 不是 words）

phrases.en: If you want something with the same ___ feeling, ___ is great.
phrases.zh: 推薦類似作品的萬用句型

phrases.en: I'm really into slow-burn mysteries.
phrases.zh: slow-burn＝慢熱型劇情

phrases.en: Can you walk me through it?
phrases.zh: 請對方一步步解釋（食譜、流程都可用）

phrases.en: First... / Next... / Then... / Once it comes to a boil... / Finally...
phrases.zh: 一句一步驟的五個錨點

phrases.en: Let some of the fat render out of the beef.
phrases.zh: render＝把油脂逼出來

phrases.en: How was your day? Did anything fun happen?
phrases.zh: 晚餐散步問另一半的標準句（did＋原形）

phrases.en: I usually put on a show while I'm on the treadmill. It makes the workout go by a lot faster.
phrases.zh: 跑步機配影集

phrases.en: My girlfriend just got off work, so I should get going. It was nice talking to you.
phrases.zh: 理由＋行動＋道別的完整收尾

replays.q: What did you see in New York?
replays.a: I saw the Stranger Things stage show when I visited New York this March. The sound and lighting effects were incredible. It was a prequel to the Netflix series.
replays.note: this March（不加 in）；effects were（過去式）

replays.q: Do you usually go to the gym in the morning, or after work?
replays.a: I usually work out after dinner because the gym is quieter then. What about you?
replays.note: 先回答自己 → 再 What about you?

replays.q: （對方說自己早上運動）I'm a morning person—I get my workout in before the day starts.
replays.a: That's impressive. I could never work out before work.
replays.note: 把稱讚說完整，不要 That's so... 就斷掉

replays.q: Are you more of a coffee person, or a tea person?
replays.a: I'm more of a coffee person. There's free coffee in the lobby, so I usually grab a cup after my workout. What about you?
replays.note: 直接回答→細節→完整交回；開頭不要冒出不明句（I'm a common）

replays.q: Do you usually get your exercise in early, like before work?
replays.a: I usually exercise after dinner. It helps me unwind after the day. What about you?
replays.note: exercise 當動詞；false start 時整句重來一次就好

replays.a: Pretty relaxing. I caught up on some errands and just took it easy. What about you?
replays.note: 沒特別安排的週末萬用回答；caught up on errands＝處理雜事

replays.q: （想問對方吃過道地墨西哥菜嗎）Have you ever...
replays.a: Have you ever tried authentic Mexican food in Houston?
replays.note: 把問題問完整再說別的 — 不要問到一半跳去問單字

replays.a: It was a little backed up this morning, but not too bad. Do you usually take the same route?
replays.note: backed up＋一個細節＋交回；不要說 it is stuck

replays.q: （介紹餐廳週）Anything you are looking forward to this week?
replays.a: Houston Restaurant Week is going on right now, and around 300 restaurants are participating. They have set menus at different price points. Have you tried any of them?
replays.note: 兩句講完＋問句收尾，不要展開第二層解釋

replays.q: What's the difference between Italian and French cuisine?
replays.a: To me, Italian food is more ingredient-driven, while French food is more technique-driven. I usually prefer Italian because it feels more comforting. Which one do you prefer?
replays.note: 一個對比→一個偏好→交回，20 秒內講完

replays.q: （想問紐奧良治安）Is it safe there?
replays.a: I've heard safety can vary a lot by neighborhood in New Orleans. Are there any areas tourists should avoid, especially at night?
replays.note: 問地區／時段／交通；族群與犯罪絕不放同一句 — 職場紅線

replays.q: Have you been to New Orleans?
replays.a: I've been there once for a conference, but I mostly stayed at the hotel. This will be my first chance to really explore the city.
replays.note: been there（不加 to）；一次講完，不重啟

replays.a: I think short-form videos have shortened my attention span. After scrolling through Reels, even a one-hour episode feels like a commitment. Have you noticed that too?
replays.note: 三句法：主張→個人例子→交回

replays.a: First, brown the ground beef over medium heat. Next, add the minced garlic and gochugaru. Then pour in the broth and bring it to a boil. Once it boils, add the soft tofu and let it simmer. Finally, crack an egg into the pot.

challenge.title: 60–90 秒挑戰：Stranger Things 舞台劇
challenge.rule: 感覺要重啟時：停 → 換短句 → 把意思說完
steps: When & where — "I went to New York this March..."
What you saw — "I saw the Stranger Things stage show..."
What it was about — "It was a prequel to the series..."
Best detail — "The sound and lighting effects were incredible..."
Your reaction — "I would definitely recommend it..."

prep.target: 一句話一個完整想法（說完一句，再加下一句）
useToday: 三句法：I think ___. For example, ___. Have you noticed that too?
食譜五步驟：First / Next / Then / Once / Finally（一句一步）
安全問法：Are there any areas tourists should avoid at night?
reminders: did＋原形（Did anything fun happen?）；has＋過去分詞（just got off work）
80 degrees、those videos — 數字和 those 後面都複數；wins／snows 加 s
over medium heat（不是 median）；once it comes to a boil；been there（不加 to）
族群與犯罪絕不放同一句 — 問 neighborhood / time / rideshare
lastMissed: 兩場 08/06 句子重啟仍頻繁 — 目前最大痛點
紐奧良安全問題的中性框架要重練一次
60–90 秒 Stranger Things 故事挑戰還沒驗收
